summary: Iteration 58 — Product discount/promo, bonus_eligible label for admin, delivery_days=0 ('Сегодня') support. Backend pytest 7/7 passed. Frontend automation confirmed catalog list discount badge with hover tooltip, struck price + rose new price, bonus badge, delivery color tiers (green for 0/1, red for 8), admin product card mini-badges 'БОН' + 'Распродажа −20%', admin product edit modal Discount section with all 6 testids, delivery input min=0, and toast validations for empty until and value<=0. E82KPD36 (20% percent discount, until 2027-01-01, delivery_days=0) and PL420x (delivery_days=8, no discount) used as live fixtures.
critical_code_review_comments: models.py ProductCreate.delivery_days defaults to 3 but ProductUpdate.delivery_days is Optional[int]=None — PUT payload with delivery_days=0 is correctly stored (verified). Good.

computeDiscount in productHelpers.js correctly returns null when discount_until <= Date.now(), enforcing 'expired discounts do not apply' — verified by code review (no live expired fixture tested via UI, but logic is unambiguous).

individual_price priority over discount is wired via the conditional `product.individual_price ? ... : discount ? ...` in CatalogPage.js (line 153 area) — looks correct; no live fixture with both fields available, so not asserted at runtime.
Admin product card uses `bonus_eligible !== false` check ensuring legacy products show 'БОН' badge — verified.

Admin form validation triggers toasts via stacking duplicates (we observed concatenated 'Укажите положительное значение скидкиУкажите дату окончания акции'). Two separate toasts is acceptable; consider unifying or using a single toast with structured fields for tidiness.
Tooltip on discount badge uses CSS-only `group-hover/disc` (no JS state). Works on hover in desktop; on touch devices the tooltip will only show after a tap holds — acceptable for ProductCard cards.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all required testids and behaviors verified on /catalog list view and /admin product modal

seed_data_creation: Tests use existing fixtures E82KPD36 (active 20% percent discount until 2027-01-01, delivery=0) and PL420x (delivery=8, no discount). Tests restore original values in finally blocks after PUT modifications.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration58_discount_delivery.py covers GET/PUT for all discount_* fields, bonus_eligible legacy default, delivery_days=0 acceptance. Backend reads BASE_URL from /app/frontend/.env when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is not in env. Frontend ProductCard.js uses testids `old-price-{id}` / `new-price-{id}`, while CatalogPage.js inline card uses `price-with-discount-{id}` instead — both render struck old price + new price. Tooltip is CSS-hover-only (no JS state); rendered in DOM always (opacity-0/invisible until hover). Admin product card shows `admin-badge-bonus-{id}` ('БОН') and `admin-badge-discount-{id}` (label + percent). Admin form discount toggle expands the rest of the section. Validation toasts: 'Укажите дату окончания акции' and 'Укажите положительное значение скидки'.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all requested features work as specified.
